ivan-defranceski.whose: **Three men on this page carry this name, and every photograph here is of the youngest of them** — **Ivan Defranceski, born Senj 17 December 1951, died 2026**, generation 7 of the direct line and the compiler's father. *Not* the **Ivan of 1925–1995** whose band sits directly above these pictures, and *not* the **Ivan of 1943–1945** who died at two. **No photograph of either of those men is held here.**
ivan-defranceski.note: Three photographs across sixty years: the shore at about a year old, a studio sitting as a young man, and a portrait made on **12 April 2012**. **Only the last is dated by anything better than a face** — its date is the camera's own. *Each caption says what its date rests on, and one of the three has a file date this archive rejects outright.*
